name: ClothesPegGallery
job: Hang photos from a sagging string with clothes pegs; they sway in the breeze and a tapped photo unclips and floats to a large view
visitor_action: tap a photo to unclip it; tap away or Esc to re-hang it
mobile: short lines of two or three prints, tap opens full width
motion: Verlet cord sags under each print's weight and travelling gust pulses ripple along it; prints swing as pendulums from the cord points with phase-lagged paper curl and hard noon shadows; on tap the spring-steel peg snaps open, the cord rebounds, and the print floats up backlit to a lightbox (reduced-motion: settled line, prints still hung, instant open)
art_direction: Scandinavian calm: no stage, fine warm-grey cord, small flat birch pegs (#d8cdb8/#c4b79e), bare unframed prints, wall-label captions beneath in Jost; lightbox shows the photo large with an Instrument Serif caption on #fbfaf8. One ink (#1f1e1c).
